title: ID0369501-DC/Si-D/EE-[MP / R2 170001450] -PowerAllocationIssue
description:
Location
: Sauga, Estonia
Reported behavior/issue:
Customer complain about power allocation. It is 300kw charger with air cooled ccs2 cables. After first car hit SOC 70%, charger did not allocate more power to second user.
Please see attached picture in the timeline.
We have an issue with converter(s) or DC contactor(s)?
Root cause: When an EV with lower than 60% SoC, the charger will allocate as many groups as it's asked in Parameter Discovery, here the EV requested maximum of 162kW → 3 groups. Only after 60% SoC it will reallocate.
Solution: Request to have more steps in the way until 60%. It's already in the roadmap, ETA in November

additional_info.subject: ID0369501-DC/Si-D/EE-[MP / R2 170001450] -PowerAllocationIssue CRM:00315001604
additional_info.body:
Hi Anton, good afternoon.
After you reached out to me via Teams, we were able to successfully get the issue and record it.
As you can see from the photos below, here is the explanation of how it works:
During Parameter Discovery of the DC4 (LCU_ID_3) the EV requested a maximum of 162.4kW (464x350)
As such, we need to allocate 3 DC groups, which were, DC4, DC3 and DC1.
As you can see, even though the EV only needed 148kW, it requested a maximum of 162.4kW.
When the 2nd EV came to charge, it only got 80kW due to only having DC2 group available.
But after we get the SoC of the first EV to 60%, the DC1 is reallocated to the 2nd EV.
This is due to how the programming is done:
Only after 60% we reallocate the group.
This feature is already in the roadmap to be implemented in a estimated date of November.
Since this is not a service topic but a feature request, I will proceed to close the ticket. When this fix is done we should get a global notification.
Otherwise I would suggest contacting your Regional Management contact for further support.
I will wait for your feedback before closing the ticket.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
